project.visitorDecision: Decide which Lake Michigan pier lights may collect freezing spray in the next 72 hours and learn what each real place looks like without treating old photos as live conditions.
project.primaryAction: Inspect the chosen lighthouse's 72-hour NWS/NOAA-based forecast, then check official marine forecasts and view only from shore.

claims.subject: weather-context
claims.limitation: The NWS hourly product forecasts regional conditions, not observed ice or pier safety. This tool withholds stale or missing forecast evidence.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.limitation: A marine forecast does not determine open parking, stable pier surfaces, or permission to approach any lighthouse. Keep view-from-shore instructions.

decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Existing api/lighthouse-ice.js source-gated weather forecast, one native selected lighthouse ID and time in public/assets/frozen-lighthouse-desk.js; photo links only set the existing selection.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: If weather feed fails, show no live index and disable timeline and location map link. Historical photos retain archival captions and never become live observations.

scenarios.input: Open with default St. Joseph selection
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Read the source-gated weather answer beside a true historic St. Joseph ice photo, then see the bright coast-desk forecast.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Photo dated winter 2021; forecast issue time separate; safe viewing is from shore.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Selected coast button, forecast detail and map light locator switch together to the Grand Haven ID.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Grand Haven winter photo is dated 2008 with CC credit; selected NWS hours remain forecasts.

scenarios.input: Select Holland and return to St. Joseph using photo choices
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: St. Joseph name, selected light, chart and hourly readings return without an old Holland response.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Archived images do not change forecast sources or imply current ice at either location.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The historic images, linked credits, official NWS references, four FAQ explanations and safety warning remain readable.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No model score is fabricated without JavaScript; missing feed is visibly unknown.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: All forecast selections, named locations, Google Maps lighthouse coordinate link and photographic credits remain usable.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: This page does not contain an embedded map or parking directions and must not infer open approach routes.

scenarios.input: Block or expire the NWS forecast source
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The source fallback says no reliable verdict, blocks the timeline and never presents an all-clear for a pier.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The historical photo still loads but remains explicitly not live.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Legible editorial heading, source names, location links and forecast controls remain, without using another light's photo as a stand-in.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The missing image never becomes a current-camera result or a fabricated location match.

failures.no-js: Static image, source citations, four FAQs and explicit shore-access warning stay in HTML without any client forecast score.
failures.no-tiles: No tile map is required. Explicit lighthouse coordinate links remain external and are not parking directions.
failures.no-image: HTML photo subjects, dates and license captions plus link navigation remain present; a failed image does not cause false live-photo or wrong-light substitution.
failures.stale-data: Existing source-gated hourly engine fails closed, with a weather source link and disabled controls, never a reassuring zero icing verdict.

qa.scopeNote: Full mocked source, licensed local WebP actual image decode, photo selection, no-JS and mobile acceptance must be checked before review.
